summary: A checkpoint keeps the history of an observer's resource observations that their readers walk back through, not only the newest: the newest observation of each attribution, the earliest that names an opener, a pull request's observations back to the newest one outside "open and out of the merge queue" (the idle nudge's merge-queue check), and every observation of a resource described in flat facts. Checkpoint rules move to version 23, and the kind can now join local trimming

replay.detail: No claim is written or read differently; a checkpoint keeps more of resource.observed.

rules.detail: RULES_VERSION 23 replaces the newest-only resource.observed rule with a keep-set. Members agree on a shared checkpoint only when they run the same rules, so a member on an earlier version holds shared checkpoints until all run 23. A member that trims locally plans its own cut and is not held; resource.observed is not yet in its trimmed kinds.

downtime.detail: No restart beyond the normal upgrade.

recovery.detail: Reverting returns to version 22, whose newest-only rule can drop history the merge-queue check and the projection read.
